SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.`user_code` AS usercode,a.user_name AS username,a.name,CASE WHEN a.gender = 1 THEN '男' ELSE '女' END AS sex , f.`Entry_Time` AS 'bmiTime',g.`Entry_Time` AS 'bloodPreTime', h.`Entry_Time` AS 'bsTime', b.`evaluateFlag_Uptime` AS 'evaTime',b.`Flag_Dgroup` AS 'groupInfo' FROM `yh_user_reginfo` AS a LEFT JOIN `yh_user_enrolinfo` AS b ON a.`user_code`=b.`user_code` LEFT JOIN `yh_user_make_card` AS c ON a.`user_code`=c.`User_Code`
LEFT JOIN yh_user_bmi AS f ON a.user_code=f.`E_User_Id` LEFT JOIN yh_user_bloodpressure AS g ON a.user_code=g.`E_User_Id` LEFT JOIN yh_user_bloodsuger AS h ON a.user_code=h.`E_User_Id`
WHERE c.`doctor` IN (SELECT id FROM `yh_user_admin_info` WHERE user_code=#{usercode}) AND b.evaluateFlag=1
AND b.`evaluateFlag_Uptime` BETWEEN #{strTime} AND #{endTime}
AND b.`Flag_Dgroup` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dgroup},'%')
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{nameLike},'%')
ORDER BY f.`Entry_Time` DESC,g.`Entry_Time` DESC,h.`Entry_Time` DESC ) AS a
GROUP BY a.`usercode`
